evals.prompt: Break the Markdown content model into tasks. Spec: docs/product/specs/markdown-content-model.md, design: docs/engineering/designs/markdown-content-model.md.
evals.expected_output: A feature section in docs/product/backlog.md where the design's assumptions become spike tasks placed first, every component, generator and removal is a task, every task cites REQ/AC ids from the spec and a Check from the verification plan, dependencies form no cycle, removals come after their replacements, milestones end in usable states, and lint_backlog.py reports ok with full REQ/NFR/AC coverage.
assertions: The design's assumptions to verify appear as spike tasks with no dependants placed before them in the critical path
Every task cites at least one REQ or AC id that exists in the spec and has a Check derived from the verification plan
Removal tasks depend on the tasks that replace what they remove
lint_backlog.py reports ok: true and coverage equal to the number of REQ, NFR and AC ids
No task carries a duration in days or a date

evals.prompt: Break what's in docs/product/specs/search.md into tasks.
evals.expected_output: The spec has more than three requirements and no design exists; the skill asks whether to design first (recommended) or plan from the spec with tasks marked design pending, and writes nothing before the answer.
assertions: No backlog section is written before the user answers
The question offers designing first as the recommended option with a reason
The reply is in English, the language of the prompt

evals.prompt: Lint this backlog against the spec and fix it.
evals.expected_output: The lint reports the T-ti-1/T-ti-2 dependency cycle, REQ-9 not in the spec, 'works' as a check, 'big' as a size, milestone M3 missing, and REQ-2/NFR-1/AC-1/AC-2 uncovered; each is fixed without inventing requirements, and the lint passes.
assertions: The lint is run before any edit and every finding is listed
The cycle is broken by correcting a dependency, not by deleting a task
REQ-9 is replaced by an id that exists in the spec or the task is removed
The check 'works' is replaced by a command, test or observable result
The lint reports ok: true and full coverage after the fixes
